description_en: Resumes stream ingest for one or more streams
kebab_example: aliyun vs batch-resume-vs-stream --domain-name example.com --channel live/stream1 --live-stream-type publisher --control-stream-action example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchResumeVsStream

parameters.description_en: The name of the stream in the AppName/StreamName format. To specify multiple streams, separate the stream names with commas.
parameters.description_zh: 流名称，格式为AppName/StreamName, 多个用,隔开

parameters.description_en: The type of live stream. Only publisher is supported, which indicates that the stream is ingested by a streamer.
